backfill.note: 只统计不写库：历史行 budget_used 的变更属不可逆证据面改动，由 owner 决定是否 apply；本脚本只给出可回填/不可回填的实数。

queries.window_totals: SELECT count(*) AS terminal_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE budget_used IS NOT NULL AND budget_used <> '{}'::jsonb) AS budget_used_nonempty, count(*) FILTER (WHERE budget_used ? 'tool_calls') AS budget_used_has_tool_calls FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until
queries.verdict_distribution: SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(fail_stage, ''), NULLIF(result->>'fail_stage', ''), NULLIF(result->'evidence'->'checks'->>'fail_stage', ''), NULLIF(result->>'stop_condition', '') ) AS verdict, count(*) AS n FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.cap_distribution: SELECT COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls', 'unset') AS cap, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'succeeded') AS succ, count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) IS NOT NULL) AS usage_known, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) >= COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls','')::bigint - 5 ) AS near_cap, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) >= COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls','')::bigint ) AS at_cap, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) ) FILTER (WHERE status = 'succeeded')::numeric, 1) AS p50_tool_calls_succ FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.usage_fact_availability: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE budget_used ? 'tool_calls') AS from_budget_used, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$') AS from_result_tool_calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$') AS from_heartbeat_progress, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+') AS from_detail FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until
queries.backfill_classification: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) IS NOT NULL THEN 'backfillable' ELSE 'not_backfillable' END AS klass, count(*) AS n FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.not_backfillable_sample: SELECT id, status, COALESCE(budget->>'max_tool_calls','unset') AS cap FROM tensor_dev_missions WHERE status = ANY(:terminal) AND finished_at >= :since AND finished_at <= :until AND COALESCE( CASE WHEN budget_used ? 'tool_calls' AND (budget_used->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (budget_used->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (result->'progress'->>'tool_calls')::bigint END, CASE WHEN (result->>'detail') ~ 'tool_calls=[0-9]+' THEN substring(result->>'detail' from 'tool_calls=([0-9]+)')::bigint END ) IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
